The '''Mos Entha hotel''' was located in the settlement of [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]], on the desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Description==
The hotel has a rectangular multi-storied central section, topped with a round dome. Behind this, was a circular tower with an antenna rising from the top. At the front of the hotel was circular reception building which was reached by a number of stairs. This was surrounded by a courtyard area with a few gardens and awnings for shade. The whole hotel comples was built out of sandstone.

==History==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operative [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hantor Loftus]] operated out of this hotel, dispatching [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] on a number of missions to undermine the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. On one occasion, Loftus had a spacer escort [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jaxa Lian]] back to the hotel, in order to protect her from being captured the Imperials as part of their [[Project Lasercutter]].
